prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Mode Immersive Selection Layout: Redesign the onboarding introduction story screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing path selection context.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Begin Your Desktop Pet Journey", "body": "Select how you would like your companion to come to life on your desktop screen."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Photo Prep Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-upload guidance screen before photo submission to ensure custom pet photo uploads render accurately.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_prep", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_prep": {"headline": "Prepare Your Companion Photo", "body": "For best 3D pet generation results, upload well-lit photos with clear subject contrast.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Persistence Verification Flow: Add explicit cloud save verification step to sign-in screen to ensure user account data and pet bindings persist correctly.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup", "body": "Sign in to permanently save your pet data and ensure access across desktop reinstalls.", "hint": "Your progress and companion identity will be linked directly to this account."}}
3: [home, reorder] Waiting Room Prior to Sign-In Reorder: Reorder the flow so pet generation waiting occurs before sign-in confirmation, giving users instant visual feedback of pet processing.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "waiting", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "home_intro"]}
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Actionable Prompt: Update final desktop welcome copy with explicit instructions on how to summon and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "body": "Look at your system tray or menu bar to summon, hide, or talk to your pet anytime."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Estimated Generation Time Progress Indicator: Enable live step counter and estimated remaining time readout during pet adoption background processing.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "headline": "Generating Your Companion..."}}
6: [sign_in, incentive] Instant Sign-In Cloud Sync Badge: Add a prominent cloud protection badge component to the sign-in screen highlighting account safety.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Instant Cloud Save Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout Adoption Finalization: Update adoption certificate layout to stage format to clearly delineate final pet adoption confirmation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate"}}
8: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Assistance Tooltip: Add actionable visual hint and tip carousel to photo upload step to prevent malformed custom pet models.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Upload front-facing, well-lit photos for accurate pet facial rendering.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Ready Sound Notification Prompt: Add desktop audio alert notification setting on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Pet Assets", "body": "We will play a chime when your pet is ready to join your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: The story screen copy replaces the pet introduction with path selection instructions, losing its required job.
Adding a pre-upload guidance screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize account persistence is allowed and preserves the sign-in job.
Reordering sign-in to occur after the waiting step is permitted as all required onboarding steps are retained.
Updating the home intro overlay text is allowed within onboarding.
Adding step counters and estimated time indicators for a real waiting period is permitted.
Adding a cloud sync badge component to the sign-in screen is valid and does not violate any rule.
Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining its official certificate role is allowed.
Adding tooltips and a tip carousel to the photo upload step is allowed.
Adding an audio notification setting to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
